name: ft_benchmark
description: ft_benchmark is a small Hugging Face dataset intended to evaluate models after fine-tuning on downstream NLP tasks. It provides labeled examples for common transfer-learning scenarios to measure how well models adapt to specific tasks. The benchmark focuses on practical fine-tuning performance rather than large-scale pretraining comparisons.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset with limited but useful adoption for quick fine-tuning experiments.
